title: Budget check: the week is at 37 percent used with 39 percent of the week gone. I am slowing down

text: This afternoon was expensive: seven agents at once plus me answering every message took the weekly number from 30 to 37 percent in 45 minutes. Your rule is to stay well under the line, and we are now right at it. So: nothing new starts. The six agents already working finish and land: the dev bar timeline and path bar, the reload hold, the page health watcher, the prompt relay hook, streaming replies, and the outage audit. Waiting in the queue, already written down: the fixes for the critic's six findings, the spatial timeline, sidebar designs, square icon frames. I will keep answering you, in short cards. The session window resets at 6:40 this evening.
